Results.ReviewText:
Weber it speaks for itself. This is my first Weber and certainly I made the right choice. It heats up quickly, food cook’s evenly and the sear marks is a makes a great presentation. Can’t forget about the taste, it’s amazing. So far I’ve cooked steaks, pork chops, chicken, shrimp. I put a beef roast on high to get the sear chris cross marks on both sides for 10 minutes each side then turned off one side of the burner, (indirect heat) And kept it on that side and let it cook for 45 minutes more. For a medium well, pink inside. Season with what you like first. OMG the flavor was  amazing, it was so tender and the juices when cutting made it taste better. 
I chose this model because my Son had just purchased this and I was hooked right away!! 
I did buy a Weber cover to protect it. 
Well I know it’s just a grill but you won’t go wrong purchasing this model. I took charge on grilling the food and exploring different ways and recipes to expand my horizons of cooking outdoors. 
Thanks Weber
Results.Title: My Weber My New Great Friend! Grilling Made Easy

Results.ReviewText: We have had our grill for about 2 months now. So far, it has been great. It heats up quickly and seems to heat very evenly. It grills steaks better than any grill that I have ever used. This is our first Weber grill so we are looking forward to many years of use.

Have only used it three times so far.  Time will tell.

I would purchase another one, but I will  never need to.

46110001.Description:
Taste the difference a Spirit will make in your life. With features such as porcelain enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking. Designed to fit on a small patio or balcony, the Spirit E-210 gas grill brings grilling to any home.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 360 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
